about.title: About the project
about.intro: The aim is to support business in Kabul on a one-stop-shop principle. The centre simplifies export-import, partner search and investment processes. It creates a secure, clear and official environment for companies from Uzbekistan and Afghanistan.
about.pageIntro: Uzbekistan Business House in Kabul operates on a one-stop-shop principle: entrepreneurs resolve legal, financial, marketing and logistics matters in one place. The centre simplifies trade and investment links between companies from Uzbekistan and Afghanistan and reduces risk. An official environment, reliable data and practical partnership mechanisms form the foundation of the project. The goal is to accelerate export-import processes, build the right business connections and strengthen bilateral economic cooperation. Every client receives a clear roadmap and professional support.

services.title: Services
services.intro: The Kabul centre brings 12 service lines together — so an entrepreneur does not need a separate office for every issue.

items.title: Legal services
items.text: Contracts, registration and advice on local legislation.
items.detail: Company registration, licences and permits. Contract drafting, legal review and dispute support. Practical advice for operating under local law.
items.whoFor: Uzbek and Afghan companies before opening an office or signing a contract.

items.title: Accounting and tax
items.text: Bookkeeping, reporting and tax compliance support.
items.detail: Day-to-day bookkeeping, tax calculation and reporting. Financial documentation aligned with local requirements. Audit readiness and tax-obligation oversight.
items.whoFor: Companies and representative offices operating or launching in Kabul.

items.title: Market research
items.text: Afghan market, pricing and competitor analysis, target segments.
items.detail: Analysis of market size, pricing and competition. Defining target segments and buyer profiles. Practical recommendations for export and pricing strategy.
items.whoFor: Exporters and distributors entering a new market.

items.title: Office in Kabul
items.text: Workspace, meeting rooms and a registered address.
items.detail: Equipped workspaces and meeting rooms. A registered address and office infrastructure. Short-term and permanent rental options.
items.whoFor: Companies that need an office in Kabul without buying a building.

items.title: Interpretation
items.text: Spoken and written translation in Uzbek, Dari, Pashto, Russian and English.
items.detail: Spoken interpretation in Uzbek, Dari, Pashto, Russian and English. Written translation of contracts and official documents. Language support for meetings and negotiations.
items.whoFor: Teams handling meetings, contracts and official documents.

items.title: Transport and transfer
items.detail: Airport meet-and-greet and in-city transfers. Secure accompaniment to business meetings. Transport on an agreed schedule.
items.whoFor: Delegations and business guests arriving in Kabul.

items.title: Visa and migration
items.text: Documents, invitation letters and process support.
items.detail: Visa document packs and invitation letters. Process follow-up and advice. Organisational support before travel.

items.title: B2B meetings
items.text: Partner matching, meeting plans and office rental.
items.detail: Matching and introducing vetted partners. Meeting plans, negotiations and office rental. Building result-oriented business connections.
items.whoFor: Companies seeking a buyer, supplier or investor.

items.title: Exhibitions and events
items.text: Stands, forums and tailored event production.
items.detail: Preparing and renting exhibition stands. Organising forums, seminars and special events. Connecting participants and partners.
items.whoFor: Companies showcasing products or services at exhibitions.

items.title: Export-import and guarantees
items.text: Contracts, certificates, customs and guarantee mechanisms.
items.detail: Drafting and agreeing export-import contracts. Certificates, customs clearance and documentation. Reducing risk through guarantee mechanisms.

items.title: Office in Tashkent
items.text: Workspace and address in Tashkent for Afghan entrepreneurs.
items.detail: Workspace and address in Tashkent for Afghan entrepreneurs. Infrastructure for meetings, negotiations and representation. Practical support for entering the Uzbekistan market.
items.whoFor: Afghan entrepreneurs entering the Uzbekistan market.

items.title: Warehouse and logistics
items.text: Storage, cargo tracking and supply-chain support.
items.detail: Short- and medium-term cargo storage. Tracking and supply-chain management. Logistics support for export-import operations.
items.whoFor: Trade and manufacturing firms needing warehousing and distribution.
